summary: Iteration 7 — Full end-to-end regression pass across the entire Vitality app (7 screens, 11 modals, all special features). Backend pytest 20/20 pass. Both frontend and server npx tsc --noEmit clean (0 errors). Re-seeded demo data before Playwright runs. All screens render with seeded data, root '/' redirects to /dashboard, persistent AppLayout + BottomNav + FAB work across all routes. All 11 modals open via their triggers and close cleanly. CRUD flows via TanStack Query invalidation confirmed: Add Drink -> Dashboard water 750->1000ml; Add Workout preset -> appears in Activity todays-workout-item-0 without reload; Add Meal (Lunch 'Test Salad' 250kcal) -> appears on Nutrition; Edit Weight 57.2->55.5kg reflects on Profile weight card AND Dashboard metric. Notification deep links n1/n2/n3 all route correctly and n2 opens Quick Actions modal on dashboard. Explore & Podcast search + category chip filters both filter correctly (empty state on no-match verified). Mini-player persistence VERIFIED with SPA navigation via bottom-nav: hidden on /wellness/podcast, visible with correct track title ('Sleep With Me Bedtime Stories') on /dashboard, /explore, /activity, /profile; toggle & close buttons functional. Mindful Master cap fix from iteration_6 CONFIRMED FIXED: after crossing goal (backend podcastSessionsCompleted=7), UI subtitle correctly reads '3/3 podcast sessions completed' with UNLOCKED status (Math.min clamp working). Achievements modal newly-unlocked celebration verified: confetti canvas rendered + '🎉 Milestone Unlocked!' toast displayed.

special_features.Confetti + toast on Mindful Master newly: PASS (verified in this run — confetti canvas + '🎉 Milestone Unlocked!' toast visible)

critical_code_review_comments: AudioPlayerContext state is component-local (React useState) so any full-page reload / page.goto in Playwright resets the player — this is expected React behavior, not a bug. In-app SPA navigation via BottomNav preserves state correctly.

Mindful Master cap fix (Math.min(podcastSessions, PODCAST_GOAL)) on AchievementsModal.tsx line 60 is a clean one-line clamp and works as intended; the raw counter still increments backend-side but display stays bounded.
Previously noted (iteration_6) POST /api/v1/podcasts/:id/listen non-idempotency remains — accepted/deferred per main agent note.
